question: Why can even a wise person be afflicted despite contact with the nectar of essence?
premises: There is reference to the tip of nectar
There is burning by the essence of juice
Even a wise person is affected
inference: Even the wise may be burned when exposed to the intense essence at the tip of nectar.
uncertainties: The yogic referent of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa is not explicit.
plain_english: Even the wise person may be burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
